# WeCall

> WeCall (wecall247.com) is a managed offshore real estate acquisition agency. It builds dedicated cold calling and acquisition desks for U.S. real estate wholesalers, fix and flippers, buy-and-hold and BRRRR investors, and portfolio scalers.

## Entity facts

- Company name: WeCall. Also known as WeCall 24/7 and WeCall247. Website: https://www.wecall247.com
- Founder and CEO: Mohamed Kotait.
- Category: Outsourced real estate cold calling, lead generation and acquisition virtual assistant (VA) services.
- Market served: United States. Offshore team: Egypt.
- Team: Egyptian cold callers, Lead Managers and Acquisition Managers trained in U.S. real estate acquisitions.
- Origin: Founded by active U.S. real estate acquisition managers, not outsourcing middlemen.
- Strategies supported: wholesale, fix and flip, turnkey and BRRRR rentals, and creative finance (Subject-To, seller financing, lease options).
- Starter Desk: $1,500 per month. Includes 1 dedicated full-time cold caller (160 hours per month), 10,000 stacked and skip-traced records, custom scripts, a predictive dialer and daily QA.
- Lead benchmark: 10,000 calls yields about 45 motivated seller leads (the WeCall 45:1 ratio).
- Upcoming Millionaire Desk: $5,500 per month (regular price $6,500). Includes 3 cold callers, 1 Lead Manager and 1 Acquisition Manager with at least 5 closed contracts, plus the SMS Lead Generation Engine. Proven average: 5 closed contracts every 90 days.
- Lead qualification: every lead is audited against the 4 Pillars of Motivation: Condition, Timeline, Motivation and Price.
- Lead delivery: pre-vetted leads arrive in the client's CRM with call recordings, property notes and comps.
- Integrations: ReadyMode, CallTools, GoHighLevel, REsimpli, Podio, REISift and BatchData.
- Onboarding: buy box, scripts and CRM setup are completed within 48 hours.
- Capacity: WeCall onboards a maximum of 10 acquisition desks per quarter to protect QA and lead quality.
- Contact: admin@wecall247.com. Strategy calls: https://calendly.com/wecall247
